journals.name: IEEE Access

review.notes: one resubmission after a (conditional) reject; no revision ping-pong

journals.aims_scope: IEEE's multidisciplinary gold-OA megajournal across all IEEE fields; judged on technical soundness/quality, not novelty or impact.

paper_reviews.aims_scope: IEEE's multidisciplinary gold-OA megajournal across all IEEE fields; judged on technical soundness/quality, not novelty or impact.

journals.name: Protection and Control of Modern Power Systems

apc.note: diamond OA, free; confirm on IEEE Xplore after publisher migration

review.notes: fastest power journal here; selective ~66 articles/yr

journals.core_rule: FREE + fastest + highest IF, but scope = protection/control/fault/stability ONLY
journals.scope_constraint: protection, control, fault diagnosis/location, stability, resilience (incl. AI applied to these)
journals.aims_scope: New theories/technologies in protection and control of modern power systems: relay protection, fault diagnosis/location, stability & control, DER integration, resilience, and data-driven/AI methods applied to protection/control.
desk_reject: off-scope: generic ML/forecasting with no protection/control angle

paper_reviews.full_name: Protection and Control of Modern Power Systems
paper_reviews.aims_scope: New theories/technologies in protection and control of modern power systems: relay protection, fault diagnosis/location, stability & control, DER integration, resilience, and data-driven/AI methods applied to protection/control.

journals.name: CSEE Journal of Power and Energy Systems

apc.note: CNY 800 / USD 120 per page from 2026-01-01; verify

review.notes: ~40% desk-rejected at preliminary examination; rapid-communication fast-track exists

journals.core_rule: broad smart-grid / data-driven power; Q1 society journal on IEEE Xplore
journals.aims_scope: All aspects of power & energy systems incl. renewable integration, power electronics, integrated/multi-energy systems, sensing/big-data, and energy cyber-physical systems.

paper_reviews.full_name: CSEE Journal of Power and Energy Systems
paper_reviews.aims_scope: All aspects of power & energy systems incl. renewable integration, power electronics, integrated/multi-energy systems, sensing/big-data, and energy cyber-physical systems.

journals.name: IEEE Open Access Journal of Power and Energy

review.notes: rejected papers barred from resubmission for 3 months

journals.core_rule: power systems + IEEE brand; APC-funded (not free)
journals.aims_scope: Planning, design, operation, and control of equipment and power systems for generation, transmission, distribution, storage, and usage of electric energy.

paper_reviews.full_name: IEEE Open Access Journal of Power and Energy
paper_reviews.aims_scope: Planning, design, operation, and control of equipment and power systems for generation, transmission, distribution, storage, and usage of electric energy.

journals.name: Energies

review.notes: MDPI SuSy; Section + heavy Special-Issue model; DORA (negative results ok)

journals.core_rule: broad energy engineering with a clear application; DORA; major-revision norm
journals.aims_scope: MDPI's broad gold-OA energy journal: energy engineering, power systems, renewables, storage, efficiency, conversion, fuels, techno-economic and energy-policy analysis.
desk_reject: no clear energy relevance / out of scope

paper_reviews.aims_scope: MDPI's broad gold-OA energy journal: energy engineering, power systems, renewables, storage, efficiency, conversion, fuels, techno-economic and energy-policy analysis.

journals.name: Electronics
journals.core_rule: applied EE/CS, soundness over novelty; section-routed
journals.aims_scope: The science of electronics and its applications: EE/electronic engineering, computer science, embedded/IoT, power/industrial electronics, communications/networks, circuits, semiconductors, control, and AI/ML applied to electronic systems.
desk_reject: pure theory/math with no electronics/computing system

paper_reviews.aims_scope: The science of electronics and its applications: EE/electronic engineering, computer science, embedded/IoT, power/industrial electronics, communications/networks, circuits, semiconductors, control, and AI/ML applied to electronic systems.

journals.name: Applied Sciences

review.notes: ~32 Sections + Special Issues; desk-rejects out-of-scope in ~7 days

journals.core_rule: very broad applied science/eng; application over theory; section-routed
journals.aims_scope: Very broad multidisciplinary applied natural sciences and engineering; emphasis on applications and experimental/numerical validation over pure theory.

paper_reviews.aims_scope: Very broad multidisciplinary applied natural sciences and engineering; emphasis on applications and experimental/numerical validation over pure theory.

journals.name: Sensors
journals.aims_scope: Science and technology of sensors, sensing systems, and their applications; the sensing/measurement/transduction element must be central.
desk_reject: pure ML/algorithm with no real sensing element
generic IoT/networking with no measurement contribution

paper_reviews.aims_scope: Science and technology of sensors, sensing systems, and their applications; the sensing/measurement/transduction element must be central.

journals.name: Machines
journals.aims_scope: Machinery, mechanical engineering, and machine/mechatronic systems: electrical machines & drives, motor control, mechatronics/robotics, machine fault diagnosis/condition monitoring, powertrain.
desk_reject: generic AI/optimization/signal-processing with no physical machine/drive/control system

paper_reviews.aims_scope: Machinery, mechanical engineering, and machine/mechatronic systems: electrical machines & drives, motor control, mechatronics/robotics, machine fault diagnosis/condition monitoring, powertrain.

journals.name: Mathematics
journals.core_rule: genuine mathematical contribution required (optimization / ML theory)
journals.aims_scope: Broad mathematical sciences, pure and applied; a genuine mathematical contribution (theorem/proof, rigorous model, convergence/complexity, well-founded numerical/optimization/ML-theory method) is required.
desk_reject: applied ML/engineering with no mathematical novelty ('we ran a model')

paper_reviews.aims_scope: Broad mathematical sciences, pure and applied; a genuine mathematical contribution (theorem/proof, rigorous model, convergence/complexity, well-founded numerical/optimization/ML-theory method) is required.

journals.name: Sustainability
journals.core_rule: substantive sustainability / SDG angle required (not decorative)
journals.aims_scope: Environmental, economic, and social sustainability and sustainable development; the sustainability/SDG/impact angle must be substantive.
desk_reject: pure engineering/ML with only a token 'sustainable' mention
sustainability claim asserted but not evidenced
neighbors: Renewable & Sustainable Energy Reviews / J. Cleaner Production (Elsevier)

paper_reviews.aims_scope: Environmental, economic, and social sustainability and sustainable development; the sustainability/SDG/impact angle must be substantive.
alt_venues: Renewable & Sustainable Energy Reviews / J. Cleaner Production (Elsevier)

paper_reviews.aims_scope: One of the largest journals; all natural sciences, medicine, psychology, and engineering; judged solely on scientific/technical validity, not importance/impact. Original research only (not standalone reviews).
